Hearing Bibishana's words, Ravana, the Lord of the Titans, 
in a violent rage, answered him saying :-
" 0 Scourge of Thy Foes, to slay an evil-doer is no sin, 
therefore I shall make an end of this worker of iniquity." 
Hearing this infamous and unscrupulous speech, essentislly

a messenger though innumerable punishments have been 
ordained for them. Mutilation of the body, the whip, stripes,

brief.summary_1line: Ravana orders Hanuman’s execution, but Vibhishana intervenes, arguing that killing a messenger violates justice and royal duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands bound before Ravana’s throne while the enraged ten‑headed king orders his death in the court of Lanka.
Vibhishana steps forward in Ravana’s royal hall, calmly pleading for justice as courtiers watch the furious king.
